sources.title: Official rules (synthetic)
sources.normalizedText:
SYNTHETIC SPRING HACKATHON — OFFICIAL RULES
Hacking starts Saturday 2031-04-12 at 09:00 UTC and ends Sunday 2031-04-13 at 12:00 UTC.
Submissions are due Sunday 2031-04-13 at 10:00 UTC. Judging starts at 13:00 UTC.
Judging is an in-person expo: each team presents a live demo for five minutes.
Teams have at most four members.
Open-source libraries and personal code written before the event are allowed if they are disclosed in the submission.
Each submission must include a project page, a public repository link and a two-minute video.

sources.title: Official judging rubric (synthetic)
sources.normalizedText:
JUDGING RUBRIC — every criterion is scored from 1 to 5.
Technical complexity (40%): 1 = minimal implementation, 5 = deep, well-integrated system.
Usefulness (30%): 1 = unclear problem, 5 = clear problem convincingly solved.
Design (30%): 1 = hard to use, 5 = polished and intuitive.

sources.normalizedText: SUSTAINABILITY TRACK — projects must address a measurable environmental impact and must use at least one public environmental dataset.
